issues: At 800x1100 the backdrop content (sideInfo + 480px frame + gaps) exceeds viewport width by ~24px, producing a horizontal scrollbar. docW=824, winW=800. The 'Taal Tarang Garba' side title and 'KATNI ARTS & COMMERCE COLLEGE' kicker get clipped on the left. Suggest: hide/compact sideInfo under a secondary breakpoint (e.g. width < 960), or reduce gap/paddingHorizontal, or shrink sideInfo maxWidth, or lift WIDE_BREAKPOINT to ~960 so narrow landscape tablets fall back to full-width layout. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/WebFrame.tsx:17-67.

Sheet is centered in the full viewport (center X = window midpoint) rather than inside the WebFrame rail (frame midpoint ~867 on 1366 viewport). This is a React Native Modal portal limitation on web — the Modal mounts outside the WebFrame tree. Width 480 and centering requirements from the spec PASS, but the sheet visually overlaps the left-side info text. If the intent is to keep the mobile illusion, consider rendering the sheet as an in-tree absolute overlay (not Modal) on web, aligned to the frame bounds. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/StudentDetailSheet.tsx:108 (Modal) + styles.sheetWeb at line 314.

action_items: Fix tablet-width horizontal overflow in WebFrame: either (a) raise WIDE_BREAKPOINT from 720 to ~960, or (b) hide/compact sideInfo + shrink gap when width is between 720 and ~960, so docW never exceeds innerWidth. Target viewports to verify: 768x1024, 800x1100, 834x1194.

(Optional polish) Align the Student Detail Sheet with the WebFrame rail on desktop so it doesn't overlap the side info text — e.g. position via a web-only portal that uses the same horizontal center as the frame rather than full-viewport Modal center.

rca_of_issue: TABLET overflow RCA: WebFrame.tsx line 46-53 backdrop styles use flexDirection:'row' + gap:spacing.xxxl + paddingHorizontal:spacing.xl + sideInfo maxWidth:320 + frame width:480. On an 800-wide viewport the inner content track = 320 + xxxl_gap + 480 + 2*xl_padding ≈ 824-888px, exceeding 800 and producing a horizontal scrollbar. The WIDE_BREAKPOINT (720) is too low — enabling the wide layout before there is enough horizontal space for both sideInfo and the 480px frame. Mitigation: either raise WIDE_BREAKPOINT to ~960, or wrap sideInfo in a secondary 'ultra-wide' check (e.g. width>=960) so 720-959 shows only the centered frame + blurred backdrop without the side column.
